args.content:
LANDSCAPE INVENTORY:
Systems: corp.itsm, emarsys.cx, my.mes (Manufacturing Execution), sap.ariba, sap.crm, sap.ehs, sap.odm, sap.s4, sap.sf, siemens.plm, workday.hcm

ENGINEERING CHANGE MANAGEMENT (Primary):
Agent: siemens.plm:agent:EngineeringChangeAndMaterialProvisioning:v1 (BEST FIT for ProductLifecycleCompliance process)
- Automates engineering change processing & approval workflows
- Synchronizes configuration updates across product items
- Coordinates engineering changes across product lifecycle & supply chain
- Initiates, assesses, and tracks engineering changes
- Manages material provisioning tied to change workflows
- Capabilities: synchronize-engineering-changes, coordinate-bom-updates, track-change-status, initiate-engineering-change, assess-engineering-changes
- Related to EngineeringChange, Material, ProductItem entities
- Part of: proc_EngChangeAndProcurement_v1, proc_ServiceToProduction_v1, proc_QualityDrivenMfgSupplyChain_v1

MANUFACTURING CHANGE ORCHESTRATION:
Agent: my.mes:agent:ProductionChangeOrchestrator:v1
- Part of proc_ManufacturingChangeCompliance_v1 (BPMN process)

BOM COMPLIANCE & MATERIAL VALIDATION:
Agent: siemens.plm:agent:BOMComplianceValidator:v1
- Validates bill of materials against regulatory standards and restricted substances
- Checks supplier qualifications and material compliance
- Related to ProductItem, Material, EngineeringChange entities

MATERIAL & VENDOR QUALIFICATION:
Agent: siemens.plm:agent:SupplierQualificationAndMaterialCoordinator:v1
- Manages material-to-vendor mappings
- Material validation against engineering specs
- Vendor compliance monitoring
